usageNotes: Use this endpoint to create a new ZFS pool on a specific node using one or more raw block devices; the node must be online and the caller must hold the Sys.Modify privilege on /. The operation returns a task UPID — poll the task status endpoint to confirm completion before treating the pool as available. Setting add_storage=true automatically registers the zpool as a Proxmox storage entry and additionally requires the Datastore.Allocate privilege on /storage.

examples.summary: Create a 3-disk RAIDZ1 pool named 'tank' on pve1 with LZ4 compression and auto-register it as storage

tips: ashift should match the physical sector size of your drives: 12 for 4K-native drives (most modern HDDs/SSDs), 9 for 512-byte legacy drives. Mismatched ashift degrades performance permanently and cannot be changed after pool creation.
draid and draid2/draid3 levels require the draid-config parameter (data and spares values); omitting it will cause the request to fail.
Devices must not be in use by another zpool, partition table, or filesystem — use get_nodes_node_disks_list to identify eligible 'available' disks first.
lz4 is the recommended default compression for most workloads; zstd offers higher ratios for cold data at higher CPU cost.
mirror requires an even number of devices (minimum 2); raid10 requires at least 4 devices.
